en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the library.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's study
I'm getting sleepy...
Sure is dusty in here
So you finally want to learn magic, huh?

I'll help you if you want, but I'm 
a strict teacher!

You'll be a magnificent mage 
when I'm through with you!

You'll probably thank me 
through tears of gratitude!

If you're sleepy during the day, it's cuz
you're not sleeping well at night...

If you don't eat and sleep well, 
you'll stay small like me.
My chest stopped growing and—

Wait, who are you calling 
flat as a board!?

Yeah, this is no good. I'll use my 
magic to get rid of all this dust...

But...I feel like I'd only make more 
dust if I did that...

I guess I'll just clean it up normally... 
without my magic.

It'll be a pain for sure, but it'll 
help me level my magic up.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Himiko looks deep in thought...
(Nyeh...)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Himiko's inner thoughts...?
